# Third-party visual assets

The replay renderer uses these Kenney asset packs:

- **Car Kit 3.1** — https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit
- **Racing Kit 1.2** — https://kenney.nl/assets/racing-kit

Both packs are released under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 license. Attribution is
not required, but is included here to make the asset origin and license explicit.
The original `License.txt` files are retained inside each downloaded pack.

The renderer also uses these Poly Haven textures:

- **Asphalt Track** — https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_track
- **Leafy Grass** — https://polyhaven.com/a/leafy_grass

Both textures are released under CC0. The checked-in 1K JPG files are the diffuse
and OpenGL normal maps downloaded from Poly Haven's official asset CDN.
